text:
sam (design): quick thought: move schema errors out of page-level banner into a compact inline "validation pin" on each function row. keeps the editor cleaner and makes scanning defs faster. sketch attached.
yusuf (devex): agree. proposal: pin on list row with small badge count. clicking opens an inline panel under the row with short errors + jump links. should be keyboard accessible.
meera (backend): backend OK. will re-run linter on open; recommend debounce 250ms and cache last result for 30s to avoid thrash.
liz (a11y): accessibility notes: the inline panel should be role="region" aria-label="Function validation" and use aria-live="polite" for new errors. keyboard: Enter toggles, Shift+Enter jumps to first error, Arrow keys navigate list.
sam (design): also proposing a compact run-history card: shows tool name, one-line summary (first sentence), a tiny cost chip (tokens/$) and a chevron. expand reveals full structured output with tabs (Request / Response / Meta) and supports streaming.
pete (product): cost chip is high value for PMs. show approximate tokens and USD. rollout plan: beta at 10% org, measure expand rate and avg cost per run; revert if avg cost >10%.
yusuf (devex): UI behaviour: compact card shows a live dot when streaming. implement lazy-load: store only summary + pointerId and load full payload on expand. focus management: on expand, move focus to first interactive element and trap until closed; Esc closes.
meera (backend): data contract draft: summaryText (<=256 chars), pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, timestamp. will include storage pointers (s3/internal id). implement debounce + caching.
liz (a11y): copy changes: replace "Args" with "Call arguments" and ensure expanded panel announces "Tool output expanded". also ensure focus visible outline.
yusuf (devex): I'll write a short RFC for the pointer contract and keyboard flow. tagging @meera for backend work and @liz for a11y sign-off.
preview-bot: sam pushed playground preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/validation-pin-compact-card
sam (design): action items in thread: 1) yusuf RFC, 2) meera debounce + pointer, 3) liz a11y checklist, 4) pete metrics gate. thanks!
